item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00454","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C10","C22"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C23 is the directive expressly identified by the child as establishing the Interdepartmental Savings Bond Committee. It supplies the child's central factual premise, institutional machinery, membership structure, chairman, alternate-designation mechanism, and Savings Bond/Payroll Savings Plan purpose. The child functions as a concise renewal of support for the program created by C23. C10 and C22 share the memorandum form and requests for department-head cooperation with a named campaign chairman, but concern different campaigns and provide only weaker structural parallels.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The nation's economic welfare requires the widest possible distribution of the national debt through the continued sale of United States Savings Bonds to the people.","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS our national economic welfare requires the widest possible distribution of the national debt through the sale of United States Savings Bonds to the people","explanation":"The child closely reproduces the parent's distinctive opening justification."},{"child_excerpt":"The Interdepartmental Savings Bond Committee established by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of April 23, 1948, provides a vehicle for the effective promotion of the Pay Roll Savings Plan.","parent_excerpt":"There is hereby established the Interdepartmental Committee for the Peacetime Voluntary Payroll Savings Plan for the Purchase of United States Savings Bonds","explanation":"The child expressly invokes C23 and continues the exact committee and program that it created."},{"child_excerpt":"This Committee is composed of the heads of the several executive departments and agencies or their designated alternates.","parent_excerpt":"The Committee shall consist of Edward F. Bartelt, Fiscal assistant Secretary of the Treasury, who shall serve as Chairman, and the head of each of the several departments, establishments, and agencies in the executive branch of the Government. Each member of the Committee, other than the Chairman, may designate an alternate from among the officials of his department, establishment, or agency","explanation":"The child's description of membership and alternates is materially derived from C23's operative machinery."},{"child_excerpt":"Any of you who will be unable to work personally with the Committee should immediately designate an alternate from among the senior officials of your department or agency.","parent_excerpt":"Each member of the Committee, other than the Chairman, may designate an alternate from among the officials of his department, establishment, or agency","explanation":"The child adapts the parent's alternate-designation provision into a direct administrative request."}]}
